originalTitle: Bonds are going on tilt. How to play them, says Mike Khouw
summary: Warren Buffett once said interest rates are to asset prices what gravity is to matter. If the options market is correct, things could get heavy, says Mike Khouw.
content:
Warren Buffett once said interest rates are to asset prices what gravity is to matter. If the options market is correct, things could get heavy.

Case in point: the TLT, the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF , which seeks to track the performance of an index of U.S. Treasury bonds. A quick review of the fund's holdings shows that the shortest-dated maturities are just shy of 20 years away, February 2046, and the longest-dated maturities are almost 30 years away, August 2056.

Most investors consider U.S. Treasurys the safest investment in the world, and I've heard people say that because the obligation is repaid in U.S. dollars, which the government can and does create out of thin air, the U.S. cannot (or should not) ever possibly default.

To the extent that people mean there is no real credit risk (a risk that the borrower cannot repay the debt), I agree. But credit risk is not the only risk that bond investors face. They also have rate risk. When interest rates rise, bond prices fall. A bond's sensitivity to changes in interest rates is a function of the maturity of the bond. The longer the maturity, the greater the sensitivity to interest rate changes, all else equal.

This was a lesson long-term bond investors learned very painfully when long-term interest rates started rising in 2020. TLT fell ~52% from the 2nd half of 2020 through late 2023. Total returns, net of interest rates, were a little better due to coupon payments, but only slightly, because the coupons were so low. Since then, 30-year U.S. Treasury rates have largely been range-bound between the highs and lows of Q4 2023, until the past several weeks, when they broke definitively above the 2023 highs. They rose another 7.6 bps today, and options traders have been taking notice. TLT traded ~ 1.6 million option contracts on Thursday, nearly double the average daily volume, and the 856,750 put contracts traded were ~3.3x the average.

The most active contract was the October 79 put, with 123,649 contracts traded at an average price of $0.4786 per contract. One of the largest trades was the October 80/79 put spread, which traded 65,000 contracts for a net debit of $0.275 per spread, a nearly $1.8 million bet that TLT, which closed at $80.78 after hitting an intraday 52-week low of 80.665, will drop below the $80 put strike by at least the premium paid. A trader betting that TLT will fall is betting that long-term rates will rise, adding pain to the housing trade and others that need to borrow long-term money at ever-higher rates, the biggest of whom is the U.S. government itself.

Whether or not you believe rates will stabilize, observe that this is a bet that pays better than 2.6:1 if TLT falls to $79 or lower by October expiration. That's a decline of $1.78 in 35 days. If that seems like a lot for a long-dated Treasury bond to move, consider this. That's how much it moved between Tuesday morning's highs and Thursday afternoon's lows.

chineseTitle: 债券正在倾斜。如何演奏它们，Mike Khouw 说道
chineseSummary: 沃伦·巴菲特曾经说过，利率对资产价格的影响就如同重力对资产价格的影响一样。迈克·库夫表示，如果期权市场是正确的，事情可能会变得沉重。
chineseContent:
沃伦·巴菲特曾经说过，利率对资产价格的影响就如同重力对资产价格的影响一样。如果期权市场是正确的，事情可能会变得沉重。

典型的例子是：TLT，iShares 20+ 年期国债 ETF，旨在跟踪美国国债指数的表现。对该基金持有的快速审查表明，最短期限的债券距 2046 年 2 月只有不到 20 年，而最长期限的债券则有近 30 年，即 2056 年 8 月。

大多数投资者认为美国国债是世界上最安全的投资，我听人们说，因为债务是用美元偿还的，而政府可以而且确实凭空创造美元，所以美国不可能（或不应该）违约。

就人们所说的不存在真正的信用风险（借款人无法偿还债务的风险）而言，我同意。但信用风险并不是债券投资者面临的唯一风险。他们也有利率风险。当利率上升时，债券价格下跌。债券对利率变化的敏感性是债券期限的函数。在其他条件相同的情况下，期限越长，对利率变化的敏感性越大。

这是长期债券投资者在 2020 年长期利率开始上升时痛苦地吸取的教训。从 2020 年下半年到 2023 年末，TLT 下降了约 52%。由于息票支付，扣除利率后的总回报率稍好一些，但也只是略有好转，因为息票太低了。此后，30年期美国国债利率基本上在2023年第四季度的高点和低点之间波动，直到过去几周，它们才明确突破2023年高点。今天它们又上涨了 7.6 个基点，期权交易者已经注意到了这一点。 TLT 周四交易了约 160 万份期权合约，几乎是日均交易量的两倍，交易量为 856,750 份看跌期权合约，约为日均交易量的 3.3 倍。

最活跃的合约是 10 月 79 日看跌期权，成交量为 123,649 份合约，平均价格为每份合约 0.4786 美元。其中最大的交易之一是 10 月 80/79 看跌期权价差，交易了 65,000 份合约，每价差净借额为 0.275 美元，近 180 万美元押注 TLT（在盘中触及 52 周低点 80.665 后收于 80.78 美元）将至少跌破 80 美元看跌期权行使价，幅度至少为所支付的权利金。押注 TLT 将下跌的交易者押注的是长期利率将会上升，这会给房地产交易和其他需要以更高利率借入长期资金的人带来痛苦，其中最大的一个是美国政府本身。

无论您是否相信利率会稳定，请注意，如果 TLT 到 10 月到期时跌至 79 美元或更低，则该赌注的回报比 2.6:1 更好。 35 天内下跌了 1.78 美元。如果对于长期国债来说这似乎变动很大，请考虑这一点。这就是周二上午的高点和周四下午的低点之间的波动幅度。
